assumptions: Owner policy: ABS only; Polymaker PolyLite ABS datasheet values (cited) used for the leaf.
Owner policy: no screws except those supplied with the OP1; this carrier uses printed insert pins and a printed actuator insert.
ASSUMED 1.5 at the sharp leaf root and tip corners (no fillet modeled); a fillet would lower it.
ASSUMED 3 N press at the face edge 4 mm off the leaf centreline; Poisson ratio 0.35 ASSUMED (not in the datasheet); twist limit 3 deg ASSUMED.
Pivot at the end-moment PRBM point (gamma 0.7346, Howell 2001); the envelope reaches the end-force point (gamma 0.85).
ASSUMED switch base plane placed for the Zippy DF profile with a 1.2 mm insert protrusion; other profiles get their own insert length.
Printing: shell rim-down with supports under the window lintel; carrier printed with the leaf thickness along the build axis so leaf bending runs in the layer plane (ASSUMED).
Assembly: carrier in from the cavity side until the tab meets the lug, then the two pins pressed through the block into the posts; actuator insert pressed into the plunger before.
At rest the actuator does not touch the switch pin (fixed gap), so no switch force pushes the face outward; the leaf is unstressed with the tab on the lug.
design_basis.summary: Separately printed ABS carrier: face on a leaf spring, rest stop under a shell lug, fixed by two printed insert pins; the switch takes the overtravel.

flexure_checks.allowance_basis: ASSUMED half of the datasheet tensile strength (yield not published); fatigue UNKNOWN.
flexure_checks.force_basis: ASSUMED press-force band 0.3-3 N at the plunger.
flexure_checks.ratio_basis: Moment balance about the pivot: leaf tip force at 18.70 mm (end-force model, conservative for stress), plunger at 27.16 mm.
flexure_checks.stress_concentration_basis: ASSUMED 1.5 at the sharp leaf root and tip corners (no fillet modeled); a fillet would lower it.
flexure_checks.torque_basis: ASSUMED 3 N press at the face edge 4 mm off the leaf centreline; Poisson ratio 0.35 ASSUMED (not in the datasheet); twist limit 3 deg ASSUMED.

title: Side button test subject, revision 15 (separately printed ABS flexure carrier, insert pins)
unverified_requirements: 押しやすさ（押下力・ストローク感・クリック感）は実機試験していない。

Switch profiles (fixed-gap insert from datasheets): zippy_df_pin: pass (insert 1.20 mm); omron_d2f_pin: unverified (missing free_position); huano_mouse_generic: unverified (missing free_position, operating_position, plunger_width); kailh_gm20: unverified (missing free_position, operating_position, body_height, plunger_width, body_length, body_width).
Leaf: beam theory only (small deflection, rigid root, typical datasheet values, ASSUMED stress concentration and Poisson ratio); creep and fatigue UNKNOWN.
Switch bottoming force is carried by the switch (no hard stop); its maximum rated force is not in the registered datasheets (UNKNOWN).
Pin and insert retention in printed ABS, print accuracy of the 0.4 mm gaps and support removal near the leaf are not qualified.
PCB plane is ASSUMED; the real board and shell were not measured. OP1-supplied screws are not used by this carrier.
Wall checks are sampled minima of the stated parts, not a proof of minimum wall or of strength.
verification_plan: Pair overlap and bounds; declared press fits (pins in posts, insert in plunger).
Rest: outward rotation is blocked by the lug at every hinge-play offset.

Press: button with insert clear of the shell by at least 0.15 mm, and of the lug, to -2.139 deg (pin flush for the deepest registered switch), about the end-moment pivot and again about the end-force pivot 2.54 mm further out.
Twist (abuse case, ASSUMED 3 N at the face edge): at +/-1.28 deg about the leaf axis the running gap may narrow but stays at least 0.05 mm (normal presses keep 0.15 mm).
Leaf: beam-theory stiffness, press force (leaf plus largest registered switch force), static stress with the root stress concentration, and twist.
Outer form outside the side-button region matches the base skin; sampled printed walls of shell and button.
Every registered switch profile gets an insert length or is reported unverified.
